title: DollJoint 솔로 #018 · hourglass bombshell · 분라쿠 초록 관절 · 기대기 · 일본 정원 · 비주얼계 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, waist-length braids auburn hair — full body white gofun-painted wooden Japanese bunraku puppet fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid gofun-painted wood body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into smooth fitted gofun segments, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every segment ends in a round exposed ball joint seated in its socket with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted segments — BLAZING chalk-white gofun shell paint across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep forest-green painted joints and thin red silk cords tied around every wrist, elbow and knee, soft matte shell-white, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same gofun-painted wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same gofun-painted wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the doll body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones.

Background: a serene Japanese garden with raked pale gravel, a stone path, a low wooden bridge with a waist-high rail and a standard-height wooden gate, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
